The Heavyweight

“The Mountain” · Mass & Power
💪 Big hits🛡 Iron block🐢 Slow

A barrel-chested brute fed on barley, beans and pork — the classic gladiator's bulk. His weight is a weapon in itself: every blow lands like a falling beam, and lesser men break against him like waves on rock.

  • +38% Health — soaks punishment that would fell two lesser men.
  • +28% Damage — the hardest hitter in the ludus, blow for blow.
  • Iron block — stops 85% of damage, and barely staggers.
  • −24% Move speed — the sand itself seems to hold his feet.
  • Slow stamina recovery — a long, grinding fight tires him.

The Balanced

“The Soldier” · No Weakness
⚖ All-round🔋 Steady➖ No extremes

Built like a legionary on campaign — strong enough to hurt, quick enough to escape, tough enough to last. He masters no single art, but he is beaten by none of them either.

  • Even stats everywhere — no exploitable weakness for any foe.
  • Versatile — every weapon and drill improves him equally.
  • Steady stamina — fights at full strength from horn to horn.
  • No extremes — out-muscled by heavyweights, out-run by lightweights.

The Lightweight

“The Wasp” · Speed & Precision
⚡ Fastest🎯 Crits💔 Fragile

Wiry, scarred and quick as a striking snake. He cannot match a heavyweight's raw strength, but he strikes twice for every one of theirs — and a blade does not need to be swung hard to find a throat.

  • +32% Move speed — circles heavies and chooses every engagement.
  • +22% Attack speed — builds combos the crowd goes wild for.
  • +10% Critical chance and the quickest feet in the ludus.
  • −12% Health — a short fight is a safe fight; a long one is not.
  • Weak block — only 65% stopped; he must keep moving, not absorb.
